newsitem.title: USA: Transmedia Europe enters merger pact.
newsitem.headline: Transmedia Europe enters merger pact.

text.p: Transmedia Europe Inc and Transmedia Asia Pacific Inc said on Tuesday they have agreed to a stock swap merger.
Each share of Transmedia Asia would be exchanged for 0.9109 common share of Transmedia Europe, the companies said in a joint statement.
The deal is expected to be tax-free for shareholders and accounted for as a pooling of interest, the companies said.
Edward Guinan is chairman and chief executive officer of both companies, which offer restaurant charge cards, the companies said.

Transmedia Europe and Transmedia Asia have licenses from Transmedia Network Inc to offer charge cards, but a company spokesman said the combined companies are moving beyond their roots to develop services with insurance companies, banks and other large corporations.
After the merger, the company will rename itself, a spokesman said.
The combined company will exceed five million members and offer products and services to more than 45 nations, the companies said.
